origin: Original Designer WidgetBlueprint/MVVM/MMOFramework teaching assets and native C++ business logic; locally prepared engine Manny and basic shapes are referenced dependencies.
implementationRevision: Staged Development Client/Server, GameplayTag ability dispatch, Designer ButtonSlot Fill, non-resolution quality settings, verified Y-axis linked locomotion and deterministic stable MMOZone movement-base names. Native packaged smoke 8/8, death-logout 6/6 and rendered run 2e331e23dd 22/22 passed.
sourceRevisionNote: Current twelve source/navigation files were hashed from repository bytes; matching lab C++ inputs were cross-checked with the successful stable-zone Client build. Actual staged executable/IoStore identities are preserved in the packaged report. Historical Editor source and capture-time revisions remain in captureHistory and sourceRevisionHistory.

scene.description: MMOCore AddComponents matches ModularGameStateBase and builds the zone with engine shapes, lighting and sky. Fixed geometry uses deterministic stable actor names, network addressability and Static mobility. No separate authored MMO zone map is claimed.
scene.uiDescription: All visible trees are real Designer WidgetBlueprint assets. Native panel parents bind business callbacks and Manual ViewModels; CommonUI manages three stacks.

capture.mode: Two independent staged MMORPGClient.exe processes and one staged MMORPGServer.exe; native RHI SViewport capture with real Designer UMG.
capture.qualityEvidence: Both clients emitted three native culture observations with all ten scalability groups equal to 1; all 22 PNG headers checked as 1920×1080.

inspection.scope: Representative Chinese/English glyph and layout review of eight of the 22 captures; runtime behavior is established by the separate native showcase, smoke and input reports.

runtime.limits: Programmatic packaged UI/culture, native linked-animation samples and fresh-process locale restoration; physical hardware input and IME are outside this run. Eight captures have a separate representative visual review.
